C3 - Component View of Station 2 Cutting. Mirrors the actual code in the cutting-service module.
Component View: Slaughterhouse System - Station 2 - Cutting
Cuts animals into parts and fills
Owns the parts and trays and Station 2's
outbox. Lets the station keep cutting while
the network or the backend is unavailable.
[Container: Java 21, Spring Boot, REST and gRPC]
Receives what the stations report, stores
the whole chain, and answers traceability
lookups in both directions. REST on port
lookups of a single part or tray and of all of
them. The placement is a PUT because the
station resends after a failure and the
same placement must not count twice.
Turns domain exceptions into HTTP status
codes: 404 for an unknown part or tray,
409 for a duplicate id and for every broken
tray rule, and 400 for an invalid request
Registers parts, creates trays and places
parts in trays. Writes the part or tray and
the outbox event in one transaction.
Delegates the tray rules to the entity
including a derived query for trays by part
The tray owns its own rules: it accepts
only parts of its own type, it refuses a part
that would take it past its maximum
weight, placing the same part twice
changes nothing, and a part already in
another tray cannot be moved. The service
uses addPart to enforce these rules.
created trays and placements, written in
the same transaction as the data they
Every five seconds by default, sends up to
Stops on temporary failure; rejects become
FAILED. No global order across stations.
Posts parts and trays to the backend,
choosing the endpoint from the event type.
